notes.title: Update 1.03! Rebalancing!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, adventurers of Elonia!

A small rebalancing update. ^^

What’s new:

\[General] Increased gold and influence gains at the end of each chapter,

\[Necromancer Faction] Increased healing gain (from +2 to +3) and defense (from +2 to +3) for the ,

\[Necromancer Faction] Undead now have a "lifespan." After 3 game turns, a summoned undead is automatically recalled.

Enjoy! ^^

notes.title: Update v1.02! New language added!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, adventurers of Elonia!



Great news, the game is now available in German!

Note: please start a campaign from the beginning to fully apply the language change.



Enjoy! ^^
